text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tazuna-san gave an explanation
about a major event taking place at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is an event where the training sessions of pre-debut Umamusume are opened to the public.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This is a great chance for girls whose true abilities
aren't widely known yet to get some spotlight,
so please do join in!♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A hero is known by all. But the name Biko Pegasus is not yet known beyond the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This open training session might be the perfect chance to get our name out there."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, an event like that?!
If I put on an awesome run there,
will people think of me as a future hero?!
choice_data_list: Yeah! You'll be the center of attention!
Yeah! You'll definitely be the center of attention!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see. A hero's definitely
gotta stand out!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Honestly, I still don't have enough skill or running mileage...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“B-But if I bust my tail between now
and the open training day,
maybe I can still blow everyone away?!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus is small.
While that is a weakness... it also has its advantages.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since her body is already in good shape, pushing her hard even for just a few days should get her into great condition.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this!
A hero can't just sit around and wait!
It's climax time even before the debut!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(More! Even more!
Special training, special training, special training!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(A hero never shows their effort.
They just work harder behind the scenes than anyone elseeee!!)
choice_data_list: This is...!? That's an amazing time, Biko!
This is...!? That's an amazing time, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having pushed her to run at full power, her final lap clocked in at under 23 seconds for the last two furlongs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Very few Umamusume can run like this before making their debut.
Her talent bloomed with astonishing speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And on the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Deyaaaaahhh!!
Pegasus Rapid Arrooooww!!"

text_block_list.name: Observers
text_block_list.text: Ooooooohh?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible. To think there's an Umamusume who can run like this before even debuting...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, normally you wouldn't know
until you let them run a few races, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Mark my words, she's going to run like the wind!
Keep your eyes on her from now on!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oho, everyone's looking this way! Looks like they've spotted a fledgling hero in the making!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Keep your eyes on me from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus looked satisfied, having made
even more of an impact on the spectators
than imagined.

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
What immense running power. What unbelievable athletic ability.
That Umamusume is...

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text: I see, her name is Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, there was a woman standing next to me, gazing passionately at Biko Pegasus.
She appeared to be an ordinary fan from the audience, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, how's that, did you see that!?
The heroic figure of Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Trainer and this lucky mask, I was able to kick butt today just like Carrotman!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a flawless run!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
This was all possible thanks to precise orders
worthy of Captain Onion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After open training finished, Biko Pegasus was in high spirits. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
Um... excuse me!?
You're Biko Pegasus... right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right... But who are you, miss?

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm a rookie action actress.
Seeing your run earlier today really moved me.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: I love Umamusume races too, so every now and then I go check them out at all sorts of venues.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"An action actor?! Really!
Though I don't feel like I've seen you much...?"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
It's not selling at all yet...
But still!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
If you have that mask,
I might be able to put on a performance
that'll make Biko Pegasus happy.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, make them happy... but how?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Lend me that mask for a second.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus hands over a Carrotman mask.
With that, the woman puts on the mask—

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Full of nutrition! Full of justice!
Carotene charge, Carrotman!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoaaaaa~~~~~!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the older girl's action sequence, Biko Pegasus was ecstatic.
That pose was truly—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Miss, don't tell me...!!
Are you the person inside Carrotman!?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Well, even if I say 'the person inside,'
it was just being a suit actor
for minor shows, though.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't on TV, just at the local mall
and supermarket, so I doubt Biko Pegasus
saw it, though."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? The neighborhood mall!?
Then I probably saw it, most likely!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"There were troubles from time to time, too!
Like the Carrot Gun breaking,
or the villain slipping and falling off the stage."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if you remember that incident...
Then you were there, at the venue!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, awesome, awesome, it's so awesome!
It's the real deal! I'm a super-duper-massive
fan of Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Autograph, please! And a handshake, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two quickly hit it off
and talked, losing track of time. And—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see. So instead of suit acting,
you're showing your face and working as an actor now.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though having said that,
I'm not getting any work offers at all yet.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
My big dream is to become a Hollywood star!
Right now, I can barely even pass domestic auditions,
but someday, I know I will.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see, then you're just like me!
I haven't made my debut yet either.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no need to feel disappointed.
Yeah, there's no need to be disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it feels like both of them
are still standing before the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right, from here on out, I'm gonna aim to be a hero of the Twinkle Series! So you too, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm aiming to be a Hollywood hero!
I'm on the smaller side, so I'm at a bit of a disadvantage, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"We can totally blow that away!
We won't let our small size hold us back!
That's right, we are—"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: You're right, we are—

text_block_list.name: Biko & Big Sis
text_block_list.text: "We're still just getting started!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko & Big Sis
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What spilled naturally from both of their mouths was...
Carrotman's signature catchphrase.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A chance encounter before their debut.
And thus, a bond was forged between two girls with small frames chasing big dreams.
